events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: There's a strongbox at Griffin somebody will pay me handsomely to open without asking after it. Find me lawful work that pays near the same and I'll take yours instead. I'm promising you nothing past that, mind.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: Paid in full, in daylight, and nobody had to be asleep for me to earn it. Fenwick Gray would call that the long way round. Fenwick Gray has been in the same jail twice.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: A place, and nobody standing over my hands the whole while I'm near the strongbox. A lock is only there to keep an honest woman honest. Let it do its job on me and I'll stay.

events.speaker: ROISIN
events.text: I've had things give up harder than you did. I mean that kindly, which is a new sort of sentence for me.
